hero.description: Software engineer with 8+ years building production web and mobile products end-to-end: Flutter apps, React/Next.js frontends and APIs with Node.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL. Fintech, logistics, mobility, education and SaaS.

about.label: 01. About
about.title: From mobile to server, the whole product
about.p1: I hold a Computer Science Engineering degree (UCI, 2016) and have spent 8+ years designing, building and shipping applications for companies across North America, Europe and Latin America.
about.p2: I started as a Flutter mobile specialist — payments, EV charging, logistics and marketplace apps — and today I work across the whole stack: Next.js and React on the frontend, NestJS/Node.js and PostgreSQL on the backend, with payment, geolocation and real-time integrations.
about.p3: I enjoy taking a product from idea to production: architecture, data modeling, UI, deployment and CI/CD.
